name: fructus
description: Fructus - a 16-bit retrocomputer: instruction set spec and toolchain

scripts.gen: mkdir -p build && node tools/gen-customasm.js > build/fructus.asm && node tools/gen-customasm.js --noat > build/fructus-noat.asm
scripts.rtl: mkdir -p rtl && node tools/gen-immgen.js > rtl/immgen.sv && node tools/gen-lhs.js > rtl/lhs.sv && node tools/gen-dest.js > rtl/dest.sv && node tools/gen-cond.js > rtl/cond.sv && node tools/gen-compare.js > rtl/compare.sv && node tools/gen-classify.js > rtl/classify.sv && node tools/gen-ucode.js > rtl/ucode.sv && node tools/gen-isa.js > rtl/isa.svh && echo "rtl/immgen.sv rtl/lhs.sv rtl/dest.sv rtl/cond.sv rtl/compare.sv rtl/classify.sv rtl/ucode.sv rtl/isa.svh"
scripts.binutils: node tools/gen-opcodes.js --header > vendor/binutils-gdb/include/opcode/fructus.h && node tools/gen-opcodes.js --table > vendor/binutils-gdb/opcodes/fructus-opc.c && node tools/gen-asm.js --header > vendor/binutils-gdb/include/opcode/fructus-asm.h && node tools/gen-asm.js --table > vendor/binutils-gdb/opcodes/fructus-asm.c && echo "vendor/binutils-gdb/{include/opcode/fructus{,-asm}.h,opcodes/fructus-{opc,asm}.c}"
scripts.gcc: mkdir -p build && node tools/gen-gcc.js > build/_isa.h && node tools/gen-lib1funcs.js > build/_lib1.S && for f in build/_isa.h:vendor/gcc/gcc/config/fructus/fructus-isa.h build/_lib1.S:vendor/gcc/libgcc/config/fructus/lib1funcs.S; do cmp -s ${f%%:*} ${f#*:} && rm ${f%%:*} || mv ${f%%:*} ${f#*:}; done && echo "vendor/gcc/{gcc/config/fructus/fructus-isa.h,libgcc/config/fructus/lib1funcs.S}, each replaced only if it changed: every object in cc1 includes fructus-isa.h"
scripts.map: mkdir -p build docs && node tools/gen-opcode-map.js > build/opcodes.html && node tools/gen-opcode-map.js --svg > docs/opcodes.svg && echo "build/opcodes.html docs/opcodes.svg"
scripts.map6502: mkdir -p build docs && node tools/gen-6502-map.js > build/6502.html && node tools/gen-6502-map.js --svg > docs/6502.svg && echo "build/6502.html docs/6502.svg"
scripts.manual: mkdir -p docs && node tools/gen-manual.js > docs/fructus-isa.pdf && echo docs/fructus-isa.pdf
